tool_input.command:
cd <repo>
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(mission): refuse a sidecar write for a session already torn down (P1, PR #509 tail #6)

Bugbot found that holding the dispatch-pending lock across deleteFiles'
clear-through-roster-removal span (previous commit) reordered the hazard
instead of closing it: a claim/dispatch writer blocked on that lock
resumes the instant it releases, which is the instant AFTER deleteFiles
has already removed the roster. hook.RefuseIfSessionGone now checks,
inside the same locked closure as the write, that the session's roster
still exists -- runMissionClaim and both CLI/MCP copies of
bindDispatchedMission refuse with an actionable message instead of
recreating an undiscoverable sidecar. A legitimate new session reusing
the same ID is unaffected: its roster always exists before any mission
command can run against it.

Also fixes a latent internal/mcp test-fixture bug this change exposed:
testHandlerWithSessions rooted its session.Store at an unrelated
t.TempDir(), never at the same $HOME/.punt-labs/ethos the tests'
globalRoot used -- the same shape review finding J5 already found once
in internal/hook. Rooted at os.UserHomeDir(), matching production
wiring; the eight affected tests now seed a roster via seedSessionRoster.
EOF
)"
